# Failure mode observations. These are behavioral notes, not literal response
# bodies, since most produce no HTTP response at all.

# REAPER process not running / web interface not yet applied:
#   curl exit code 7 ("Failed to connect... Connection refused")
#   Identical client-side signature to "wrong port" below - the client
#   cannot distinguish "REAPER isn't running" from "nothing is listening on
#   this port" without an out-of-band check (e.g. process list), which a
#   Stream Deck plugin doesn't have. Both must map to the same
#   "Couldn't reach REAPER" diagnostic message.

# Wrong port (nothing listening on 8081, REAPER itself untouched):
#   curl exit code 7, same ECONNREFUSED signature as above.

# Busy in a modal dialog (SWS "About" dialog open on screen):
#   GET /_/TRANSPORT still returned 200 OK in ~33ms - the web server thread
#   is NOT blocked by a modal dialog on REAPER's main UI thread. This is
#   BETTER than the spec assumed for read-only state queries. Whether
#   action-firing requests (bare numeric/named command IDs) queue, execute,
#   or silently no-op while a modal is open was NOT tested this session -
#   flagged as an open question for milestone 2 hardening.

# Mid-render: NOT TESTED this session (deferred - no render was triggered
# against the live project to avoid disrupting the user's session).

# Multiple REAPER instances on different ports: NOT TESTED this session
# (deferred by explicit user choice - would have required launching a
# second REAPER process).
